root_idea.summary: The root denotes what is contrary to elevation: being low, lower, or in the lower part.
root_idea.development: The spatial idea of lower position extends to descent, lowered condition, low social standing, and related terms for lower parts, leeward position, and the lowest members of a group.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized citation form أَسْفَلُ.
Displayed as the active-participial noun سَافِلٌ.
Displayed separately because the Quranic feminine substantive سُفْلَىٰ has a distinct conventional usage.
The locative occurrences are the same lexical item أَسْفَلُ, used adverbially or as a locative expression.

senses.definition: Lower, below, or lowest in position; the lower or lowest part or place.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally and substantively, and adverbially in أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ ('below you'). It can express either relative lower position or the lowest position in a setting.

senses.definition: The lowest state or condition; in the expression أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ, the lowest of the low.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic expression is interpreted variously as reduction to extreme old age or decrepitude, perishing or decline, error and disbelief, or descent to the Fire; these are interpretations of the same lowest-state construction, not separate ordinary meanings of أَسْفَلُ.

senses.definition: Low or lower; occupying or constituting the lower part or underside.
senses.usage_conditions: The form is used substantively in Quranic constructions such as سَافِلَهَا, 'its lower part,' and in the plural for those characterized as low.

senses.definition: Low or degraded in condition; the lowest of the low.
senses.usage_conditions: In أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ, the plural participle completes the Quranic lowest-state expression. The expression has been explained as extreme decline, decrepitude, error, or descent to the Fire.

senses.definition: The lower or lowest one; the lower or lowest side in rank or standing.
senses.usage_conditions: Used substantively in جَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا السُّفْلَىٰ, where the word or cause of those who disbelieved is made lowest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become low or lower than another; to descend, subside, or sink downward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The vocalization varies by dialect and verbal pattern. The verb may describe descent from an upper to a lower part of something, or a relative lowering in position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become low, base, vile, ignoble, mean, or sordid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person's disposition, deeds, lineage, lot, or general condition; it is opposed to being good or elevated in these respects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of lowering or depressing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal noun denoting causative lowering or depression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Being lowered or depressed; descending downward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive or intransitive verbal noun, opposed to rising or elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie with or imitate someone in low, base, vile, mean, or sordid actions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction يُسَافِلُ فُلَانًا, with the person whose behavior is being imitated or matched as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower or lowest part of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is the opposite of عُلْوٌ and related terms for the upper part; it may refer to the lower part of anything.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low, base, vile, ignoble, mean, or sordid person; one deficient in condition, lot, or fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal designation derived from the sense of being low or inferior in condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low, base, or vile people; the lowest, basest, or vilest portion of mankind, the refuse or rabble.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expressions have variant vocalizations and number usage; the plural or collective interpretation is common, while application to a single person is reported but treated cautiously. In أَيْمَانُ السَّفَلَةِ, the phrase denotes the oaths of ignorant people, or, in another attribution, of heretics or schismatics.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The legs or lower limbs of a camel or other quadruped.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This anatomical usage is explained by their being the lowest parts of the animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or relating to the lower or lowest part or place; persons dwelling or remaining in the lower parts of a country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural سُفْلِيُّونَ may denote people located in the lower parts of a country, in opposition to عِلِّيُّونَ in the corresponding elevated sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low in condition or social standing; a person of low condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The social sense is opposed to elevation in condition and, in the cited contrast, to opulent or high-status people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The leeward side or quarter, toward which the wind blows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the side facing the wind's direction, especially in relation to hunted animals so that the hunter's smell is not detected; opposed to the windward side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The half of a spear next to its pointed iron shoe or lower tip.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is the lower portion of the spear, opposed to its upper portion.
An anatomical noun for the lowest posterior part of the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower group of Muḍar, excluding Quraysh and Qays.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional tribal classification opposed to عُلْيَا مُضَرَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower or lowest parts of valleys and similar terrain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural used in expressions such as كِلَابُ الأَسَافِلِ, 'the dogs of the lower parts of the valleys.'
A figurative or specialized usage reported for the plural form.

cautions: The interpretations of أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ in 95:5 include several exegetical alternatives; they are preserved as interpretations of one Quranic lowest-state construction rather than asserted as interchangeable ordinary meanings of أَسْفَلُ.
Lane's citation to the Quran in its entry for أَسْفَلُ uses historical notation; the modern locations used here are only those independently supplied by QAC.
